notes.title: Patch Notes 1.9.0.4.0
notes.content:
Hey Ranchers! Here's a small patch to fix some of the commonly reported issues since launch.


General Changes
Updated the game icon.

Fixed a bug that caused the player to get stuck in the round pen during fast travelling.

Fixed an animation delay issue when horses jumped obstacles in the round pen.

Fixed an issue where pets sometimes appeared on the player’s house roof.

Fixed some issues that caused the player to appear underneath the map after loading into a new area.

Fixed an issue that made it impossible to purchase a festival horse if you caught a wild horse earlier that day.

Fixed an issue that caused the competition countdown to sometimes start over again after abandoning a race.

Fixed the name of the Teal Classic Breeches.



Thank you for your patience and for letting me know about these issues! 

Éloïse

notes.title: Full Release Update! Festivals, Gymkhana, Pets, Achievements & More! 🐴✨
notes.content:
Howdy Ranchers! 🐴✨ The final content update is now available! This update includes the town festivals, villager friendships, farm animals, pets, a ranch expansion, achievements, new quests, new tack, and a whole lot of new horse coats! 

This last roadmap update contains a ton of new content, so get ready for our longest devlog yet!

Keep in mind that this devlog contains a lot of spoilers! If you'd prefer to experience it yourself, feel free to skip this and dive right into the game to discover what's new!

Town Festivals
Gymkhana Courses
Twice per season, Rivershine Town will host an equestrian festival! During these, you’ll be able to participate in multiple activities… Including new gymkhana competitions!

The gymkhana competitions are held in the town’s arena, and offer a generous first place prize, but you can only try it once per festival! Luckily, you’ll be able to do practice rounds before starting the competition. Either way, be sure to bring your fastest and most flexible horse!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/60aba5d1c2b1147caf7e25435ba440be1139a0f2.png
Mealy Horses
Following the gymkhana, it's time to head over to the auction house! Faraway vendors have brought in unique mealy horses that can’t be found anywhere else in Rivershine. You’ll be able to check their skills and coats, and bring your favorite horses home!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/0bb310e2ec6daa5a9bbcb289d71fa1650b3a6b26.png
The mealy pattern is available in five different strengths, from minimum to maximum. It can also be overlaid with other patterns, such as tobiano and dapples, to create unique horses!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/5480e693dcaf6e07ff812de0b14d62d0ca165bfd.gif
Festive Tack
Finally, head over to the townsquare to check out the new pop up shop the saddler has set up! Festival exclusive tack will be available to purchase, including a new baroque set. More seasonal accessories are also available, such as antlers in the winter and flower crowns in the spring!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/4ff233d96b7f2e5f0416614e2e8afe89da429456.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/60245ef2a3eca403b2fed623103fd848900061c6.gif

The baroque set includes multiple pieces and color variations, which can be collected over various festivals!

Villager Stories
Friendship Progression
Learn more about the villagers living in Rivershine as you develop your friendship with them! Each of them now has a unique story they’ll share with you over time about their past, their dreams and their worries. 

They now also have more dynamic dialogues based on the weather, the season and the festivals!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/5802f0b79bf8e4899dbfc0ab97c1c9b75d8b428f.png
Gift Tack
As your friendship progresses, you will be rewarded with unique gifts from each of them. The handwoven tack set seen here can be completed by befriending everyone in town!

Additionally, once you’ve completed your friendship progress with a villager, they will sometimes come by your ranch to lend you a hand. Each of them will complete different tasks on your ranch. For example, the farmer will feed your horses, while the carpenter will help clean their stalls!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/7f42c92904677e007af7cff590704e6e14a35db1.gif
Ranch Expansion
Map Rework
A new ranch?! Don’t worry, it hasn’t changed too much! Since I’ve added a lot of new buildings and areas to the ranch during the Early Access, I wanted to revisit the layout to make sure everything was in the best place… So a few things got moved around!

You’ll find it now takes less time to walk between your house, the stable, the retirement pasture and the farm fields. There’s also a few more buildings behind your house…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/c7e760f8844f572a52db49c54285a796683e7bc9.png
Farm Animals
A new barn and coop are now available on your ranch! You’ll be able to house a dozen chickens in the coop, along with eight sheep and goats in the barn. Be sure to feed your animals daily, which will allow you to collect eggs, fur and wool to sell for a profit!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/6136b62bddfb82adc6ced7723036c8a620bb32ea.png
The farm animals are available to purchase from Aisha once you reach your second festival. 
During the festivals, she’ll set up a small enclosure in the marketplace, where you can see which animals she has available that day!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/abdbe3e0d83d88c093cc39e7c7afa03f23305242.png
Retirement Pasture
The retirement paddock has moved to greener pastures! Your retired horses will now have more space to wander about on your ranch, and you’ll be able to see them more easily when riding around. 

You’ll be able to purchase a new upgrade for the retirement pasture, allowing you to keep up to 36 horses. The price of all the retirement pasture upgrades have been reduced in the carpenter’s store.

Additionally, the retirement pasture gates can now be opened, allowing you to walk up to your horses and check on them. That’s still the only interaction you’ll have with them though… They’ve earned their right to be pasture ornaments!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/a678449d6013bfb62276662e567cc12e2e61363d.png
House Upgrades
House expansions are now available to purchase from the carpenter's shop! Expanding your house will add new rooms, including a bedroom and a kitchen, to your house. But most importantly, it will allow you more space to keep some new companions...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/8e6363c29c79052e98b74e8791e617bd5a4608d2.gif
Pets
A dog, a bunny and a cat are ready to join you on your adventures! You'll be able to adopt these three furry friends as you expand your house. Choose to leave them to rest at home or bring them along on the trails, where they'll help you by gathering forage!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/cfb44d55c4af0480cd58d6f2d8521a174fe8e195.png
Saddlery Restock
In addition to the new tack you’ll be able to purchase during festivals and receive from the villagers, the saddlery has been restocked! Visit it to shop for two new thematic sets.

Almost 200 new tack pieces have been added in total, doubling the customization options for your horses in this update! The price for tack has also been reduced to build your collection more easily.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/970a571b4b7fde4cbc6cf1fa9a0493b495da239f.gif
This new race themed set includes saddle pads, bridles and leg wraps. Match it with your favorite race saddle!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/b93f5029306d03bc8e1ddf720f049a14562d1c6f.gif
This cute bow set includes new blankets, leg wraps and halters! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/7dbf369125dc3ec0533a49e37d259e66d4f7c4d7.gif
These new nature themed accessories will be available to purchase either in the saddlery, or during the festivals!

New Pattern Variations
Discover a ton of new pattern variations for your horses! New variations are available for tobiano, overo, appaloosa, splash, tovero and pintaloosa horses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/300ba34e66bc51945bbc5d59a1ed751ec2a319e9.gif
New Face Markings
In addition to coat patterns, new face markings have also been added to the game! These include a lot of new badger and bald face markings to allow you to find more unique horses each time you play!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/cfb480bd4826327ee8a350ede06c1e3c6c10252c.gif
Calendar
Hard to keep track of all of these morning notifications? 

The calendar is here to help you! Consult it any time during the day as a reminder of where wild horses are, which villager is visiting the town or what's happening with your horses. You'll also be able to view when the festivals are in town and when your new foals are due!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/e1b9c164e485d5d59273450334ccecf7c1155d4e.png
Full Storyline
New Introduction
If you've been waiting to start a new save file, now is the perfect time to do so! The tutorial now includes a short cinematic to introduce the story of Rivershine and your role as you arrive in town...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/742691cebe962b9384889860839aef8b6eba53ec.png
Final Statue
After winning your last competition, you'll unlock a new quest to complete the full storyline of Rivershine. This quest includes a new statue being built on your ranch, and bringing forward the mystery horse the villagers have been seeing around town...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/fd315ac45595ed46af7d8638d8951105fb1ddbc2.png
Mystery Horse
This legendary horse will reveal himself to you once you are ready... He has a unique brindle coat color and manchado coat pattern, and will surely bring forward a new generation of champions to Rivershine!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/f6827f4b301471920fca9ccd0277aa2571141777.gif
All of you will see a different variation of the mystical horse, with a random brindle color and manchado pattern for each player!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/3bcc08dfbd07e03f914434335a719dc31f83fe59.gif

Try to pair your new brindle horse with a cream horse to discover more breeding exclusive coat color variations!

Achievements
Steam achievements have made their way to Rivershine! You'll now be able to unlock over 20 achievements as you progress on your ranch. 

While some achievement will unlock on older saves, you'll need to play on a new save file to unlock 100% of the achievements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/36a24a53dc05c267f26386d1b5074ad0629aad40.png

General Changes

 Added new save slots for a total of 6 saves available.
 Added new gates to directly ride into the second and third pastures.
 Added new sheep colors.
 Changed how certain interfaces open and close to be quicker.
 Fixed the dialogue interface being cut off in certain screen resolutions.
 Fixed various issues with the crop farming.
 Increased the chance to find horses with brown or black eyes in the auction house.
 Updated the horse eye colors.
 …And a ton of smaller fixes!

What's Next?

As we've now reached the end of the roadmap for Rivershine, I'll only be updating the game to fix bugs and add small quality of life improvements. I've loved the years I've spent working on this game, and I know a lot of players would enjoy more content, but it's become increasingly challenging to add more to the game with each update. I think the full release is the perfect time to wrap up my work on Rivershine!

But, it's not the end for Cozy Bee Games! I've collected a ton of new game ideas while working on Rivershine that I'm really excited about. I can't wait to announce my next project to you all, and while I can't say much about it for now, it will most likely be a new cozy animal life sim!

Who knows, there might even be another horse game coming in the future!

Thank you all so much for following me on this journey and bringing Rivershine to life together! 

Éloïse

notes.title: Veterinary Clinic, Weather System & Cream Roan Coats! 🐴🌧️ Update 1.8.0.1
notes.content:
Howdy Ranchers! 🐴🌧️ The eight content update is here with a ton of new features, including a new villager, new forage, a weather system, and new coat colors! As we’re approaching the end of Early Access, I’ve also been spending more time on bug fixing and quality of life improvements to prepare for the full release. You can view the full list of changes below!

The Veterinarian
Meet your new neighbour, Dr. Amelia Trotter! She’ll be waiting for you in the veterinary clinic in Rivershine Town. Her clinic offers an array of remedies and poultices to treat your horses, in addition to a few… mysterious… tonics to boost your horses! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/b4db763bef9b83b4d1f05a0830da8a12517f0ef2.png
Horse Illnesses
Your horses can now become ill, depending on how they are cared for. A healthy horse will be very unlikely to fall sick, while an unhealthy horse surely will. Which illness they get will depend on their satiety, care, energy, the weather and the season.

For example, dirty horses might become ill with mud fever, which can be treated with a poultice. Low satiety can cause malnourishment, while low energy brings on exhaustion. These are treated with remedies, either purchased from the veterinarian or crafted yourself from medicinal forage!

Additionally, you might now encounter sick horses when catching them in the wild. If you choose to adopt them, it’ll be up to you to get them back in good shape!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/e467fa10814725c7087d04ec2c549e82b0358f3c.png
Remedies & Poultices
While all remedies are available for sale at the veterinary clinic, it might be worth your time to craft them yourself instead! 

First, you’ll have to purchase the recipes in Amelia’s shop, and then gather the necessary ingredients. New medicinal forage can be found to craft these recipes, such as garlic, ginger, clay and peppermint. Explore the trails to discover where they grow!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/1704a00fc75192a5e564eb712d12e362a5ea0807.png
Boosts & Tonics
In addition to remedies, Amelia sells boosts you can use for various effects on your horses. For example, you can now grow your horse’s hair faster, or freeze it to stay at the same length!

The veterinarian also offers potent tonics to boost your horse’s growth. Complete your mare’s pregnancy or help your foal grow up overnight… No need to skip days, as long as you can cover the vet’s expensive fees for her potions!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/fceb192461d3eb1740edccbc2d2745f8ac79f50f.png
Weather System
Get ready to face the elements! There is now a chance for sunny, cloudy, rainy or snowy days, depending on the season.

Keep in mind that on rainy and snowy days, your unhealthy horses have a chance to develop rain rot if they are left outside without a blanket. Healthy horses shouldn’t have much trouble with it, and it can always be treated with a poultice!

I’ve also added a new setting named “Forever Sunny” that can be turned on to prevent all weather events. This can be used if the new weather is too demanding on your computer and causes lag, or just if you prefer to keep the skies clear!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/704547821f15d88a1559587fa72898229da3a6be.gif
Foal Bottle Feed
As a little addition to foal care, you can now bottle feed your foals to gain extra trust while they’re growing up! Collect the milk from your nursing mare’s stall and give it yourself to your foal for that extra bond.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/678e3d716f5d2faf5a0323684047a9a9f3e92174.png
Cream Roan Horses
Discover nine new breeding exclusive coat colors by mixing roan and cream horses together! These include coats such as palomino roan, buckskin roan and smoky cream roan. Some of these are my new favorites - I hope you’ll enjoy them too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/cd2880d29cc5c8a97029907a4d8fd830bb36ff92.gif
General Changes

 Added four new arena obstacle courses for sale in River’s shop.
 Added a new brush for sale in George’s shop.
 Added a “Keyboard Control” setting that can be turned on to control the camera with the keyboard instead of the mouse. This setting should be particularly useful for players using a touchpad.
 Added a “Forever Spring” setting to keep the foliage and environment colors in spring all year long.
 Added a new quest with Madelaine to explain how the auction house upgrades in her shop work.
 Added a name randomizer in the horse’s interface.
 Increased the space available in the retirement pasture from each upgrade, with the last upgrade now granting a total of 24 spaces instead of 16. There will be additional changes to the retirement pasture in the next update.
 Increased the chance for the leg markings to be the same height on horses found in the auction house and in the wild.
 Added more coat colors for the NPC horses.
 Added two new travel stones in Rivershine Town.
 Added the pasture doors being open or closed to the save data.
 Changed the mouse cursor to a custom cursor.
 Changed the recipe list to be divided in categories for clarity.
 Added a “Notes” section in the inventory to record your own memos.
 Fixed an issue with the boots flickering on the male player character.
 Fixed an issue with the intermediate flower fence course caused by the obstacles being too close to each other.
 Fixed an issue where taking a horse out of the pasture to ride did not work correctly.
 Fixed an issue where wandering horses could trigger travelling to a new area.
 Fixed an issue where the arena jumps would sometimes disappear after selecting a course.
 Fixed various issues caused by pressing pause during competitions, which resulted in game breaking bugs.
 Fixed an issue where a competition could be completed multiple times from a single competition, creating various bugs.
 Changed the dapple colors on bay base horses to be lighter and more visible.
 Changed the foal behaviour so that they stay with their mom in the correct pasture. They will still be in separate pastures on the first load but after placing them together, they will stay together.
 Fixed an issue that would set a mare as not nursing while she still had a foal.
 Fixed an audio issue at the start of the game when loading in a save file.
 Fixed Gallant Deer’s name not being visible on his statue.
 Fixed the square saddle pad clipping with the pregnant mare model’s belly.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Coastal Chase competition to be marked as complete without participating in it.
 Fixed various issues with hair dyes not appearing correctly.
 Updated the tips displayed on the loading screens.
 Changed the Azure Coast competition winning times to be slightly easier.
 Removed the tameness loss from retiring a horse.
 Fixed various trail jumps in Pine Forest.
 Fixed an issue that caused the player to be invisible during the statue blessing cinematic if they were in first person.
 Fixed an issue that allowed horses to walk on the auction house’s roof.
 Fixed an animation stutter when mounting tall horses.
 Fixed placement issues with the first person camera.
 Fixed various typos.

There are also known issues with the farming and the retirement pasture, and these will be worked on in the next update.

What’s Next?
After doing some planning for the full release, I’ve decided to combine the last two updates on the roadmap, Home Sweet Home and Village Life, into a single bigger content update that will mark the full release of the game!

As planned, this update will include new additions to your ranch, pets, seasonal events and villager friendships. I have a few more surprises in store for this update to make it exciting for both new players and for those who have been playing The Ranch of Rivershine over the last two years! 

Thank you for reading and enjoy your time in Rivershine! 
Éloïse

notes.title: Azure Coast Trail, Rabicano Horses & Trust Training! 🐴☀️ Update 1.7.0.1
notes.content:
Howdy Ranchers! 🐴☀️ We’re starting 2025 strong with our seventh content update! It's time to ride along the Azure Coast trail… and discover a ton of new content in it! Catch wild rabicano horses, train your horse’s trust, participate in coastal competitions, equip new tack and learn new recipes!

Azure Coast Trail
Ride along vast beaches, listen to the sounds of waves and shelter under palm trees in this final region expansion! Collect new forage, such as watermelon and sand, and discover six new hidden chests scattered across Azure Coast. 

You might even see some shoals of fish swimming in the ocean!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/de6b8ce328e5cd3ff1d0d5fe47c57823167fd9e1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/d7fefa6a79b7510502c4d4094e00e9b8310b4108.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/954465866ef69003350d3a8c99dda0aa055cc14a.png
New Competitions
Participate in four new competitions, from beginner to expert, set on the sandy shores of Azure Coast. Once the trail is open, you’ll soon receive an invitation to compete in these new courses!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/031b63fb372bfa730b6834339559ccf844b12a52.gif

Rabicano Horses
Herds of wild rabicano horses will be roaming around Azure Coast… Be sure to build the wild horse pen, and get ready to catch them! The rabicano pattern comes in 8 new variations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/45c59563b5b21adc6b352741b239ae6ba3257523.png
New Music
Get into the beachy vibes by listening to the new Azure Coast track!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/28e20e71a1362393181fc4303c73fe11c70ab226.png
Trust Training
Walk with your horse through shallow waters, navigating around large rocks and shoals of fish to increase their trust for you. The trainer will help you get the new trust arena set up on the coast!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/17966e7e0dd400a8cddd75d4eadf5cc7cacb9915.gif

New Tack
Visit the saddler’s shop to see what new inventory is available! Equip your horse with a bitless knit bridle, a lantern accessory, or with new sheepskin saddle pad colors. Remember that some of the new pieces will be hidden throughout Azure Coast!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/1c552dd7e7f373ccfc929c7e1aa19df5b7394448.gif

Loading Screens
Travelling to a new area has never been prettier! The loading screen now features unique illustrations for each area and useful gameplay tips. 

Thank you to our community members who shared their gameplay tips!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/9c397562e1686abca74eadc404d3696010fade8a.png

General Changes

 Added flags on the sides of cross country jumps.
 Added an option in the settings menu to change the camera's vertical height while on horseback.
 Fixed the green square saddle pad not being available for sale in the saddler’s shop.
 Fixed collision issues with the flowers.
 Fixed issues with horses disappearing out of the retirement pasture. 
 Fixed an issue that caused the player to fall through the map when using travel stones.
 Fixed the competition outfit becoming permanent due to restarting a race.
 Forageable items now have a chance to give seeds again.

What's Next?

Following the roadmap, the next update will focus on caring for your horse’s health, gathering new ingredients, crafting remedies, and meeting the last villager… The veterinarian! She’ll be moving into the long abandoned clinic in Rivershine Town. 

Here’s an early look at your new neighbour!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/beadb8eb24862c4af3cd8ac193c58b1df8e53a5c.png

Thank you all for your support and I'll be back with more news soon! ❤️

notes.title: New Outfits, Hats & Hairstyles, New Villager & Coat Colors! 🐴🎁 Update 1.6.0.1
notes.content:
Howdy Ranchers! 🐴🎁 We’re wrapping up 2024 with our sixth content update for The Ranch of Rivershine. This update brings you a whole new wardrobe to customize your character, a new villager to meet, and new breeding exclusive coat colors! 

I hope you’ll all have some time to cozy up and take a look at the new features over the holidays. ❄️❤️

New Outfits & Hats
Classic, western or casual? Your choice! Mix and match pieces from each type for a unique look, and be sure to collect all of the colors available to be ready for every occasion! In addition to the new outfits, you can now wear a hat! Wear a helmet to stay safe while taming wild horses… or just for the style! 

Make sure to save your favorite outfits to quickly swap between them, and to pick your competition outfit. This outfit will be automatically equipped when you enter into a competition!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/0ba18acf12795326685667a2e7a5f7c2c03fcc87.png
Here are some inspirations for your outfits! You could have a classic aesthetic...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/397bf9c93eb395f2943a83dd2b8d41c20fda8086.gif
Or sport a good old western fit...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/098dc326dccf8e58a69cdd3725c705959ee2ed21.gif
Or try a more casual look for visiting the town!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/95f7b37af2602933fa689aa7e33111ae3ca323a5.gif
No need to start a new game to update your player’s look, simply visit the wardrobe in your house to browse through the new clothes. Your old outfit and hairstyle will be reset with the new options, so make sure to refresh your fit!

New Hairstyles & Hair Colors
New hairstyles are now available for a total of 16 different hairstyles! In addition, you'll be able to dye your hair in new colors, including pastel tones!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/f9d1bd8de05b55cf53b56f691d3e0655b5f5ad0f.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/23eb0aa7e4554c8fca9fe2c09d47291cf0109f94.gif
New Villager & Boutique
Meet your new friendly neighbour! Daphne will move into Crystal Lake and open her boutique, where you’ll be able to purchase all of the new clothing options. Her store will feature a rotating inventory with different pants, shirts, shoes and hats every day so make sure to visit her often!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/7912547f854e5fdc3b9957af613d7d7062eab1bb.png
Dunalino, Dunskin & Grulla
Discover new breeding exclusive coat colors that you’ll be able to create in your own stables! Breed together two horses with a dun coat and a cream coat for a chance to have a dunalino, dunskin or grulla foal. A total of 9 new coat colors are now available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/d545a8442bf4ea95ec13cd9227e496ac2b4e51db.gif
Horse Names
New random horse names can now be discovered in the auction house, when catching wild horses and when raising foals! Each category now has more than double the amount of names available to create more diversity and uniqueness with the horses you find.

Special thanks to our community members who shared their suggestions to add to the horse names! <3

General Changes

 Translated all new content to French.
 Added five new eye colors.
 Added new clothes and hairstyles for the visitors in Rivershine Town.
 Fixed an issue where the player would not be visible if entering the wardrobe in first person mode.
 Reduced the cost of the wild horse pen upgrades.

What's Next?
We’re back on track with the roadmap, which means that the next update will be Azure Coast! In addition to a whole new area to explore, this beachy landscape will also introduce new cross country competitions, a trust training course and rabicano wild horses!

Happy holidays everyone, I’ll see you in 2025! 🎄

notes.title: New Manes & Tails, Rare Patterns, Crafting & New Villager! 🐴🎨 Update 1.5.0.2
notes.content:
Howdy Ranchers! 🐴🎨 The Mane Salon update is here, bringing a ton of new content for your horses in this fifth roadmap milestone! Cut, style and dye your horse's mane and tail, meet the stylist, learn crafting recipes and collect new ingredients for your concoctions. 

Mane & Tail Styles
Learn how to style your horse’s mane and tail 20 different ways, from short to very long! Some of the new styles include different types of braids, straight and wavy cuts.

While these are only for your horses, worry not, as the character customization update is coming up soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/61a86320e9f7e778e9e366b9f75aaca7b65aa10b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/9a495529949a1fc2e779a6d32dc46f29d8626930.png
Hair Dye
To further customize your horse’s look, add a pop of color to their mane and tail with dye! Choose from 15 colors to match your horse’s hair to their tack or pick a more neutral look.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/641c4f845fa050cf23e8e3faaeaa415258b6196a.gif
Flower Fields
Keep an eye out for the new flower fields! Each trail will now feature a unique flower color that can be transformed into hair dye. Find chests to learn the crafting recipes, and mix the flowers together to create different dye colors!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/792817dcb4fc7156ddedc75549235f5a92363cf6.png
Handy Crafting
Turn your forage, crops and even manure into useful items! The farmer will help you get started with a few fertilizer recipes that can now be crafted from your inventory.

While only fertilizers and dyes can be crafted for now, I have plans for further recipes and ingredients to be added, especially in the upcoming veterinarian update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/32829765b97c262db14474e46ccd640f8f0fc54c.gif
New Villager
Meet Orion, the new villager who just opened the Mane Salon in Rocky Mountain! You’ll be able to learn how to style your horse’s mane and tail from his store. He’ll also help you learn how to craft your own dyes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/e2b296b9dc618ffe6510e57141fb84adc96bb42f.png
Tovero & Pintaloosa
Get ready to breed unique coat patterns on your ranch! Tovero horses can now be bred from a pair of tobiano and overo parents, while pintaloosa horses can be born from a pair of tobiano and appaloosa parents. 

What other unique pattern mix would you like to see in Rivershine?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/dc5b1f7435b0741f080eab546e0e8747b3ad0b2a.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/e1c1e4a4a8e70564fab58ff6304fd7350345f386.gif
Eye Colors
Take a closer look at the horses you catch in the wild or purchase in the auction house… They’ll now have a whole new range of eye colors! While eye colors were previously limited to specific coats, all horses can now have all eye colors. Mix and match to find your perfect horse!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/f711fe0645bb7551cbfcc55a4488363935b05980.gif
General Changes

 Added “Farm” category items available for the player to sell, such as seeds and fertilizer.
 Removed the compost bin.
 Increased the statue's fame gained from stone circles.
 Increased the cleaning speed of the brushes.
 Improved the brushing particle effects.
 Fixed issues with the screen staying black after screen transitions.
 Fixed a bug where you could use the fast travel before selecting a location.
 Changed how items spawn to create more clusters and more forageable items overall.

What’s Next?
While I initially planned on the roadmap to add Azure Coast next, I’ll switch the next two updates around and instead add the Fashion Boutique update first! It will allow you to customize your character better and purchase more outfits from a new cozy villager… You’ll soon be riding your horses in style!

Thank you for following the development of The Ranch of Rivershine!

Éloïse

notes.title: Horse Personality Traits, Round Pen & Fast Travel! 🐴🌷 Update 1.4.0.2
notes.content:
Hi Ranchers! 🐴🌷 We have a ton of new content packed in our fourth roadmap milestone, including discovering your horse’s personality traits, lungeing foals in the round pen, raising horses of different heights and fast traveling to key locations!

Round Pen
The round pen on your ranch can now be restored! Build it to lunge your foals and wild horses and prepare them for riding. While both foals and adults can use the round pen, foals learn twice as fast while they’re young.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/f2feb48d8b2c13166d49d1e40502ad97dea323c7.png

You can train all four skills by changing your horse's gait, adding jumps in the round pen or shortening the lead's length to train your horse's flexibility. If your horse doesn’t respond to your command, make sure to calm them down to improve their tameness!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/02203d8c9cb1c6679f4ab3e5fadb13dbb3b263eb.gif
Horse Tameness
Wild horses and foals aren’t so tame anymore! You’ll now need to train a new skill for your horses: Tameness!

This skill will impact how well a horse responds to your commands. For example, an untamed horse might just rear or buck when you ask them to accelerate, but as they improve, they’ll listen to you more and more often until they are fully tamed.

Tame your horses by lungeing or by riding them and calming them down when they buck. Wild horses are untamed, but luckily, horses bought at the auction house are fully tame, so you won’t have to worry about them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/adc34d240c8f04927f01c5ae80b1e51cbaeae2f6.gif
Horse Personalities
All of your horses will now have three unique personality traits! Each trait falls under a category:


 Training: This trait impacts how fast and where your horse can be better trained, for example by training in speed twice a fast or by losing less energy when training at home.

 Caring: This trait changes how your horse needs to be cared for, for example by always having a clean coat or being able to eat two treats daily.

 Earning: This trait allows you to earn gold in various ways with your horse, for example by finding gold while riding on the trails or by earning extra gold from the competitions.

Your current horses will all receive personality traits at random when you load up your save file! For future horses, you’ll be able to see their traits in the auction house and your foals will have a chance to inherit their parent’s traits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/a726020407c1e1c52ec05c954e0e83f130875824.png
Horse Height
Since this feature was highly requested, I decided to include it as a bonus in this update! All of the horses you’ll encounter in Rivershine will now have varying heights, from 14H to 16.2H. Your current horses will stay the same size and stand at 15H tall. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/15bca5a22d7721815813ad72e6b9d5f7454db8c0.gif

When breeding horses, your foals will have about the average of their parents, and you’ll see their height go up each day as they grow. Young adults will now also grow over time and reach their full height once they become adults!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/0686e6c08241ddbc436fd4ae41c2a0c8fb7d7bf7.png
Travel Stones
Mysterious stones have appeared in key locations across all of Rivershine… It might be useful to take a closer look at them, as they will allow you to fast travel around the trails!

Help the villagers of Rivershine to learn more about the stones and gain the ability to travel through them. The villagers will also shine more light onto the mystery of the town, but there will still be more left to discover…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/ce2a335c50b962162eb69c5d79fddcc39b83bf1a.png
Stone Circles
Along with the travel stones, you’ll find stone circles around the town and trails. These will reward you for exploring and grant money, potential, energy or statue fame as you pass through them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/cbbedf66b41daa727857e875175492c89a2a8f3a.png
General Changes

 Translated all new content to French.
 Improved the horse jump animations.
 Added four new shades of base black coat colors.
 Added more random colors for the NPC’s horses.
 Added coat genetic information to the fertility pasture interface.
 Fixed a game-breaking bug that caused the player to get stuck when trying to adopt a wild horse.
 Changed horse energy to be replenished after spending a night in the fertility pasture.
 Fixed a bug where the Rocky Mountain statue would charge up before the quest for it is available.
 Fixed a bug that caused the competition start and end gates to stay visible after finishing the race.
 Fixed the foal brushing hitbox.
 Fixed foals being able to reach 100% care.
 Fixed horses losing their dapple coat color when they are placed in retirement. This won’t restore dapples for previous horses but it won’t happen again with future horses.
 Fixed the jump training arena in Crystal Lake not unlocking correctly after purchase.
 Changed the indoor arena and grain descriptions to clarify how they impact training.
 Increased the foragable item spawn chance.
 Changed where grains spawn to match the trail’s training bonus.
 Fixed the Rocky Mountain music stopping abruptly.
 Reduced all tack cost by half.
 Increased the time required to break quickly to reduce instances of stopping by accident.
 Change the questline so that the Lupine Meadow and Rocky Mountain expert races don’t unlock at the same time.
 Fixed an issue where the horse’s energy bar wouldn’t visually increase after feeding a treat or resting at a hitching post.
 Added sound effects for the foal’s footsteps.
 Fixed the horses and foals not being led correctly out of the stable.
 Fixed issues with horses being duplicated when loading a save.
 Removed the ability to “ride” foals by resetting to the map’s entrance.

What’s Next
The next content update will be focused on opening the stylist’s boutique! Along with meeting a new villager, you’ll learn how to cut your horse’s hair in new styles… And more ways to make your herd look pretty!

Thank you for following the development of The Ranch of Rivershine!

Éloïse

notes.title: Rocky Mountain Trail, Dapple Horses & New Tack Colors! 🐴🌻 Update 1.3.0.0
notes.content:
Hi Ranchers! 🐴🌻 We’ve now reached the third milestone on The Ranch of Rivershine’s roadmap: The Rocky Mountain trail! This area opens up a ton of new content including new competitions, wild dapple horses, new tack colors, a flexibility training arena, and a new horse statue! 

Additionally, The Ranch of Rivershine is currently on sale! It’s a perfect time to grab the game and head onto the mountain trails!

New Trail
The Rocky Mountain trail features steep inclines, hanging bridges, and herds of wild goats! You’ll be able to ride around this new area and upgrade it with cross country obstacles, a wild horse pen, and a flexibility arena... And don't forget to look for the three hidden tack chests!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/b7125e949ebfd387ec667faa1b79860e02889b95.png
A new lively track will also be playing on this trail... Give it a listen here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/55cfd6de0fccf76abd9ecd93c2853f20b49d2d1d.png
New Competitions
After opening the Rocky Mountain trail, you'll have access to four new cross country competitions. If you've already unlocked all the competitions, these will all become available instantly. If not, you'll unlock them as you progress through the questline!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/b46a57a78c8cccf1fdfe4f07541a1fe5546730ca.gif

I've also created two new obstacle sets to decorate these new courses!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/4aa88ff5d8139b03e32e1590933d55d13793e529.png
Flexibility Arena
The flexibility arena is finally here! Wave around a line of barrels to pass through the flexibility checkpoints and quickly train your horse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/44519397862cb37820c7cc89892959fbe566eadc.gif

Purchase this arena from River and upgrade it twice after that to use it multiple times per day. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/ebf2b3bbf6fbb78309acbee472541034ee97eac1.png
Dapple Coats
The wild horses sighted in Rocky Mountain have interesting coat colors… It's dapples! After building the Rocky Mountain wild horse pen, you'll be able to catch these horses and add them to your stables.

Dapples are a new type of coat modifier and can be mixed with all coat colors and patterns. This results in a ton of new coat color combinations to discover! Dapples are available in five different strengths, from minimum to maximum.

Here’s an example of how the different dapples look on a black horse!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/a5a2c33454c15de749869292f08d2b9b1e830044.gif
Tack Colors
All the tack is available in new colors at the saddlery! The fabric tack has four new shades: pink, purple, teal and orange! The leather tack also has two additional shades: light brown and dark brown. 

Here's a preview of the new fabric color range!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/b448b38b75899e237321ed2c8c86b58473e91d7a.png
Since the horse interface was getting a bit too cluttered with all the equipment, I’ve also reworked it to make it easier to find the color you want!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/97484e960bc24fef5070b16d1c2c5b6203ea0003.png
Balance Changes

 Reduced the cost of early upgrades and tack items.
 Changed all competition times to be a little easier.
What's Next?

For the next content update, I'll be tackling the foal training! This will allow you to interact with your foal in new ways and do more activities with them. Alongside that, I'll also implement horse personalities to make each of your horse more unique!

If you'd like to see more development news and participate in beta testing for upcoming updates, be sure to join the official The Ranch of Rivershine Discord!

Thank you for reading and happy trail riding everyone! 
Éloïse

Upgrades

 Added icons on the map for retired horses.

notes.title: Rivershine🐴✨A Year in Review!
notes.content:
As 2023 is coming to an end, I thought it would be fun to review everything that happened at The Ranch of Rivershine this year, and look ahead to what will be coming in the new year! 🐴✨
A Look Back
Demo
On January 20th, I released the demo that gave you all a first impression of The Ranch of Rivershine. After working on it for two years, I was really excited to finally put the game in your hands, and over 20,000 people played it! 

The demo only contained the ranch, the town, a handful of villagers, and was limited to the first season. Still, some of you played the demo on repeat, and racked up dozens of hours of playtime! It motivated me to get the Early Access ready, and with a lot of notes and feedback, I got back to work…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/a9f81f365735a0e35edb798c759ccb93bae2d44b.png
Early Access
On May 12th, the Early Access release went live on Steam! This version included the much awaited foals, in addition to new trails, new villagers, more quests and four seasons. Since then, we’ve had a very active community on Discord talking about their time in Rivershine and sharing cute pictures of their horses!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/8d0d5a77ff0df35583e47b497089ee07d31121ef.png
Content Updates
After a summer of bug patches following the Early Access release, I started working on the content updates and released the Wild Horse update in September, followed by the recent Saddlery update in December. If you haven’t played the game since the initial release, you have a lot of new content to discover including the wild horses, new training arenas, new ranch upgrades, a new villager and the saddlery opening in town!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/fe4160e2730801730ad494596faafe108d284068.png
The Road to Full Release
Back in November, I released a roadmap of the upcoming content updates that will lead up to the full release of The Ranch of Rivershine. As you can see, we still have quite a lot to go! While I initially planned on finishing the game in 2024, I now expect the full release to be in 2025. 

While this is a delay for the finished game, it just means that I’ll spend more time working on it and adding more features to it. If you haven’t seen the roadmap yet, have a look at it here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/693be0ebde271bfd2e8edb12130650d9a8147403.png
Next Update
Before I start creating the next content update, which will be Rocky Mountain, I’ll be working on a smaller update in January that will include bug fixes, balance changes, and smaller additions I’ve wanted to make for some time. For example, this will include the ability to sprint, to pet your horses, and to jump in the saddle from the back!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/df48a63a1c7477ffb0fc7c7c73872507ecc37236.gif

Happy New Year everyone, and I hope to see you at The Ranch of Rivershine in 2024!

Éloïse

notes.title: Saddlery, New Horse Tack & New Villager! 🐴❄️ Update 1.2.0.3
notes.content:
Hi Ranchers! 🐴❄️ The second content update for The Ranch of Rivershine is ready just in time for the holidays! It's time to visit the saddlery in town, tack up your horse with new equipment, and wrap them up in a blanket for the cold season! We also have some additional improvements to the game with wild horse pen upgrades, a statue tracker and more bug fixes!

New Tack
Your horses are ready for a new style! You’ll now be able to equip your horse with a much wider variety of bridles, saddles and saddles pads. In addition to that, I’ve also added new types of tack such as leg wraps, breast collars, halters, accessories and blankets.

Feel free to mix and match the equipment to your liking, as it won’t have an impact on your horse’s performance or abilities. Just choose what looks best to you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/d1dce10808da7fed1a8d8f19d3cc4936e81a7a48.gif
To fit in all the new types of tack, the horse interface is now separated into two sections. The first one contains all of the horse care actions, while the second one contains the horse tack options. I’ve also added a new medicine action, which will be expanded on later during the veterinary content update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/7220b95dace4a3a4e591291b7e92b065893018e8.png
Old Saddlery
A new store is open in town! The saddlery works a bit differently than other stores as it features a rotating inventory, so make sure to visit it daily to see all the new tack. You’ll be able to view the tack available for sale that day before purchasing it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/064cfb8f42d640a53bf817f9ef17310cc1b8fd1e.png
New Villager
And to run the saddlery, a new villager moved into town! Shin Dae lives in town and crafts all kinds of horse tack. He’ll help you get started with equipping your horse by gifting you some pieces, and then sending you on a treasure hunt!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/71fe2749352418401bfc1c786c8701afdac6e07d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/f031e7a89f13cd87068c9d2415b92cf504901aa2.png
Tack Treasure Hunt
Make sure to look in the best hiding spots and find hidden chests all over the town, ranch and trails to gain unique tack! There are currently 3 hidden chests per area, each containing a new piece of tack you can’t find anywhere else.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/2847bd231c0bad5a83077b9c6db5d4b9f54f8fea.png
Keep track of how many chests you’ve found with a new addition on your map!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/41f726ac7e89c3bb0fd66faa51190286fe3a8967.png
Horse Statue Tracker
You’ll now be able to save yourself some time by keeping track of the horse statues in the quest interface. Each statue has its own progress bar that will start updating once you complete the quest for it, so you can easily keep track of your progress with each of them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/17b4760bba50ea7fe248c7e2f35187cab3607f6f.png
Wild Horse Upgrades
I’ve received feedback after the last update that it would be more fun to improve the wild horse’s skills as the game progresses. In this update, you’ll be able to purchase upgrades for the wild horse pens. This will allow you to improve the maximum skills wild horses can have, from beginner to expert! 

Once the corrals are fully upgraded, you’ll find all sorts of horses, but you can get lucky with a horse that has all expert skills!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/29e6130290536e66c61a3951bb8169718b84698e.png
What's Next?
For the next content update, I’ll be working on the Rocky Mountain update! This will include a whole new area to explore, four new cross country competitions, a flexibility training arena and new wild horses with a unique coat color to catch. 

This will be quite a big update, but I’ll be sure to keep you all updated on my progress in the Cozy Bee Game’s Discord server. Make sure to join if you’d like to follow along with the development of The Ranch of Rivershine!

General Changes

 Added multiple entrances around the wild horse pens to make it easier to corral horses.
 Reviewed the breeding system so that the coat colors and coat types of both parents are mixed correctly.
 Changed the horse’s statue so that they only glow when the quest to use them is complete.
 Changed the order of some quests to improve the early game’s pace.
 Translated all new content to French.
Bug Fixes

 Removed all rocks from Pine Forest to prevent wild horses from getting stuck on them.
 Fixed a bug that caused wild horses to get stuck around the maze in Lupine Meadow.
 Fixed a bug that allowed inspecting wild horses before bringing them in the round pen, which could get the game stuck.
 Fixed a bug where foals would run around the pasture while the horse interface is open.
 Fixed a bug that allowed taking out a horse of retirement even if no stall were available, which caused the horse to disappear from the game.
 Fixed a bug that caused horses taken out of the retirement pasture to always have a short mane and tail.


Thank you all for reading my devlog and I hope you’ll enjoy this new saddlery update!
 
Happy holidays! Éloïse

notes.title: Wild Horses, Retirement Pasture & New Training Arenas! 🐴🍀 Update 1.1.0.0
notes.content:
Hi Ranchers! 🐴🍀 I'm really excited to share with you all the first content update for The Ranch of Rivershine! This update allows you to catch wild horses, build new upgrades such as training arenas, a retirement pasture and a competition board, along with many other fixes and quality of life improvements. 

It's the perfect time to dive back into Rivershine or build your ranch for the first time!

Wild Horses
It’s time to saddle up and chase wild horse herds! You’ll now be able to see them roaming the trails around Rivershine… Get ready to catch them! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/add89e089b609ca713167d436cba5c6e35c23a21.png
First, the park ranger will send you a message to build wild horse pens on each of the trails. Once built, there’ll be a chance for wild horses to arrive on those trails every day. If wild horses are present, the ranger will send you a message to let you know… And it’s time to set out and find them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/0ec3c206b81ec10d1c924bebf87f9e0aa9920710.png
Once you encounter them, the wild horses will be scared and run away from you. To approach them, you’ll have to chase them from horseback and guide them into the round pen. They’ll settle down once they enter the corral, and you’ll be able to take a closer look…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/a27fa520e7e8ffea1ebf5410334f1ede3179663a.png
Befriend the wild horses by petting their head, and then inspect them from all sides. This allows you to see the wild horse’s coat, gender, and skill level. You can corral and inspect as many wild horses as you like, but you can only choose one to bring back home, so pick wisely… 

Luckily, a new herd will pass by the trails in a few days!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/5ab4e2f379fae8aa4b94c6521c97551534b819fa.png
Horse Coats
Wild horses have a chance to feature exclusive coat colors and patterns. You'll be able to find a unique type of coat on each trail, so make sure to catch horses everywhere you go! For example, here are the unique splash patterns you'll be able to find in Lupine Meadow...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/1dafc644778802907c241571dda23ddaddf5def0.gif
I’ve also reworked and expanded on the previous pattern types, so you’ll be able to find new variations of appaloosa, tobianos and overos. Here's a quick look at what these new patterns look like!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/2a5342a67000acf53b358eefe4a99ed06d32f341.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/ad9a62f45bdeaf04ad7d63dd506dfb5c32354e79.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/b6447908aa97f66e92cb3900c4efe4fb36528b90.gif
Training Arenas
New training arenas are available to purchase from the trainer’s store! These arenas are designed to improve a specific skill, such as speed, endurance or jump. Each of them can be built and upgraded twice to train your horse even further daily.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/43cf90e3a0f2b0d6de3c052aafb918618e795b3e.png
To train your horse, simply bring them to the arena and pass through the training checkpoints at the correct gait. Your horse will quickly improve their skills, but the arena can only be used once per day!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/886547b79d4555813e596af9de15ba343b9d26c3.png
Retirement Pasture
Since it’s been a much requested feature to keep more horses, I've added a new pasture on the ranch! The retirement pasture allows you to keep horses you’ve grown attached to even if you’re done training and competing with them,  without occupying a stall in your stable. Of course, you can always take them out of retirement and bring them back to your stable if you change your mind!

The retirement pasture can be built and upgraded twice to keep up to 16 horses. While horses are retired, they can’t be interacted with, but they also don’t need to be cared for… So you don’t have to worry about feeding or brushing them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/ccac93e8bb0e9f912adb05058280ad54cc82dd7c.png
Competition Board
Finally, I've also added a competition board that can be built on your ranch! This will allow you to register for competitions from your home and easily change between horses to compete with.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/9ecf897ac6a4a01a2895148c36d12fb8ddbb44de.png
Change List
For more information, here’s a detailed list of the changes and bug fixes included in this update!

Coat Colors & Patterns

 Added 14 new cream coats colors.
 Added 10 new splash coat patterns.
 Added 8 new sabino coat patterns.
 Added 4 new tobiano coat patterns and improved the older ones.
 Added 5 new overo coat patterns and improved the older ones.
 Added 6 new appaloosa coat patterns and improved the older ones.
 Added 20 new face markings.
 Changed how the face markings are inherited so that foals inherit a marking more similar to their parents.
 Reduced the chance for horses to have a badger or bald face marking.
 Adjusted the bay and roan coat colors.
 Fixed the silver gene inheritance.
 Changed how the flaxen and silver genes work to be more realistic. Chestnut horses now can’t have silver hair, only the bay and black horses can. Instead, all chestnut horses can now have flaxen hair. 
This won’t impact current silver chestnuts in your save file, and they will stay as is, but no new silver chestnuts will appear in the game. However, as I had to change how the flaxen is applied to horses, horses who previously had the “Flaxen Chestnut” coat will change to a new coat called “Sandy Chestnut ''. While I try my best not to impact current coats, it happens from time to time during Early Access as I update different systems. I hope you’ll still like this new chestnut coat, and you’ll now be able to find more variations of flaxen horses!

General Changes

 Changed that horses lose a potential point if they spend the night in the pasture. If they’re kept in the stable, their potential doesn’t go down.
 Moved the location of Liam’s house.
 Updated the map icons for better clarity.
 Added map icons for the training arenas and the fertility pasture.
 Improved the collision detection to interact with horses.
 Reduced the price of the Pine Forest and Crystal Lake trails.
 Added cucumbers, pumpkins and pears for sale in Aisha’s store.
 Translated all new content to French.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed various issues with the mane and tail not growing correctly or saving and loading the wrong hair style.
 Fixed a bug where the horse coat description wouldn’t update in the auction house.
 Fixed a bug where you could collide with foals before they were born.
 Fixed a bug where selling a horse in the auction house could then cause multiple horses to share the same stall.
 Fixed a bug where young adult horses would have the wrong hairstyle after growing up.
 Fixed various typos and updated descriptions to fit the new content.
 Changed the auction house horse for sale list to exclude horses that can’t be sold.
 Fixed the sand and dirt sound effects in Lupine Meadow.
What’s Next?
For the next content update, I’m planning on adding a new villager and opening the saddlery in town! You’ll be able to purchase new saddles, blankets and bridles… I might also add other accessories for your horses to wear! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/6ac899c8767abbbef466e50e8bcb2c2e3bb9b098.png

Thank you for following the development of The Ranch of Rivershine!

Éloïse

notes.title: New Horse Coats, Mane & Tail Customization! 🐴 Update 1.0.1.0

Hi Ranchers! I’m very excited to share this update which includes new coats and improves on the genetics system. You’ll find new coat colors, both available in the auction house and from breeding your horses, and the ability to change your horse’s hair. I’ve also fixed various bugs and added some quality of life fixes. Here’s a full list of the changes!

Horse Update

 Implemented that the horse's mane and tail grows over time.
 Added an option in the horse care interface to cut your horse’s mane and tail.
 Added new color variations, for a total of 16 new coat colors.
 Updated the genetics system so that horses inherit coats with a combination based on the coat color (bay, chestnut, black) and the coat type (base, dun, roan).

Stall Update

 Fixed a bug that prevented assigning a young adult horse to a stall, even though empty stalls were available.
 Fixed a bug that made young adult horses take over a stall that was already occupied.

I believe most of the current horse management bugs are due to horses sharing a stall, and all the pregnancy issues, foals following a horse that isn’t their mother etc. all come from there. Fixing bugs that cause horses to share a stall (like the ones mentioned above) at the source should prevent issues like that from happening in the future. Make sure to review your stable manager at the entrance of your stable and move your horses to their own stall if they’re sharing the same one!

General Update

 Added that the guide arrow automatically changes color depending on the season.
 Fixed a bug where horses could turn in a circle while jumping an obstacle.
 Fixed a bug where multiple days could be skipped when going to bed.

Balance Update

 Reduced the cost of the fertility pasture.
 Increased the auction house bidding difficulty.
 Removed the daily potential loss.


Thank you for your patience while I work on Rivershine! ❤️ I'll soon start creating the wild horse update which will be released later this summer! ☀️

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.0.5
notes.content:
Hi Ranchers! Here’s a quick update to fix issues with the stalls, quests, competitions and the difficulty level of the game!

General Update


 Fixed a bug where the Lake Dive competition didn’t unlock after receiving the quest for it.
 Fixed a bug that created the Crystal Lake quest twice.
 Fixed a bug where the “Red Wine” and “Gallant Deer” quest descriptions didn’t update correctly when they were ready to be completed.
 Fixed a bug where horses above 75% flexibility skill couldn’t be trained further.
 Possibly fixed a bug where you’d get stuck before a jump. I wasn’t able to recreate it on my end so I can’t confirm it’s fixed, but I found a code issue that might have caused this. Let me know if it’s still happening and I’ll look at it again!
 Added the expert cavaletti course in River’s store. More expert courses to come!

Stall Update


 Fixed a bug where horses bought at the auction could take over an already occupied stall.
 Added that if a mare is sold at the auction house while she has an unassigned foal, the foal will automatically be assigned to the sold mare’s stall.
 Reviewed how stalls are assigned to fix various bugs related to the horses taking over the wrong stall. 
 Added a Stable Manager at the front of the stable. This will allow you to assign your horses to a specific stall, which can be used to resolve bugs where multiple horses have taken over one stall. You’ll also be able to view all of your horses and send them to the stable or pasture from the Stable Manager.

The shared stall bug will not be fixed instantly by updating the game, but you’ll be able to rearrange your stable depending on the problem you were having. It’s a bit tricky to fix problematic save files in addition to preventing future bugs, but this should fix the issues you might currently be having:

To fix multiple horses sharing the same stall:
[olist]
 Look through your horse list in the stable manager and find horses that have the same current stall number.
 Select “Change Stall” and assign all of the horses sharing a stall to a new empty stall.
 Once all horses have their own stall number, you can rearrange the stable to your liking! Make sure they each have a unique stall number before moving them to avoid bugs.
[/olist]
To fix multiple mares sharing the same foal:
[olist]
 Look through your horse list to find all the mares sharing the same current foal and current stall number. They will all be set as “pregnant”, even though only one foal exists.
 Select the mare that you want to keep as pregnant or nursing first, and select “Change Stall” to assign her to a new empty stall. This is the mare that will keep the foal.
 The other mares will stay as “pregnant” for the rest of the current day but will be back to normal and without a foal the following day.
[/olist]
To fix horses stuck in the fertility pasture or somewhere you can’t reach:
[olist]
 Find your lost horse in the horse list of the stable manager.
 Select “Send to Stable” and check if your horse is back in the stable.
 If this doesn’t work, it might be because your lost horse is sharing a stall with another one. Make sure they each have a unique stall number to avoid bugs.
[/olist]
Balance Update

Added a difficulty setting to choose between normal and story mode. The story mode removes the need to place first in competitions to progress. Instead, you’ll be able to instantly complete the competition quests to progress in the story line. The difficulty can be changed at any time, both on new and old saves. You can still participate in the competitions if you want to, but if not, you can make money in others ways, such as:

[olist]
 Farming and selling crops
 Training and selling horses
 Breeding and selling horses
[/olist]
I’ll add other ways to earn money throughout EA to help players who don’t enjoy the competitions as much, but hopefully this difficulty option will already allow you to enjoy the game! Make sure to change the difficulty setting after loading your save file for it to work correctly!

Thank you for your patience while I fixed the issues! I think this update will help with the most critical issues that have been found since the release. I’ll be continuing to bugfix the game in the next few weeks and once it’s more stable, I’ll start working on new content! I hope you’ve been enjoying your time in Rivershine!

notes.title: Devlog #10 Foals & Seasons! 🌸🍀🍂❄️
notes.content:
Hi ranchers! 🐴🌸 It’s been a little while since my last devlog, as I spent a lot of time working on the demo. Thank you to everyone who played it and shared their feedback with me! The demo will stay available to play until we get closer to the Early Access release, if you feel like going for a ride in Rivershine! Moving on from the demo, I’m now back to present one of the most anticipated features in Rivershine… raising your own foals!

Breeding Horses
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/a1d73787d059f1bf79165ace146eed1532c725f7.png
Fertility Pasture
The first step to raise your own foals is to have at least one mare and one stallion to breed together in the fertility pasture. You’ll be able to browse between your horses in this interface to pick the pair you want to breed together. Once selected, they’ll be placed in the pasture together. 

Depending on your horse’s health, care and trust level, they will have a varying percentage chance of breeding successfully every day. Once the mare is pregnant, both horses can be taken out of the fertility pasture.

Coat Genetics
I’ve decided to create a genetic system that isn’t exactly realistic, but instead that fits Rivershine’s gameplay more uniquely. This could be changed later based on feedback but I think it’ll be a fun way to breed horses! Here’s a quick explanation of how genetics work in Rivershine.

Each unique coat color is part of a “type” of coat color. For example, the chestnut type includes multiple coats, such as the flaxen chestnut, light chestnut, red chestnut and liver chestnut. The foal will have a 50/50 chance of inheriting one of their parents' type of coat color. They will then be assigned at random a color that is part of this type.

The same is true for coat patterns, which are layered on top of the coat color. Keep in mind that if one of the parents has a pattern and the other doesn’t, the foal will have a 50/50 chance of inheriting a pattern or not. If the foal inherits the pattern type, it won’t necessarily have the exact same pattern as the parent and will instead have one of the available coat patterns of that type at random.

As an example, let’s breed a pair of horses together and show the possible results for the foal! Here we can see that a foal born from a black tobiano stallion and a bay roan mare might have one of these coats…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/4550829a7736f78e643b72b3ae63fb09aa2c2d20.gif

For now, the face and leg markings are not inherited from the parents and are set randomly for the foal. This might be changed to include a chance of inheriting those markings from the parents too. Later on, I’d also like to expand this system and add unique coat colors and patterns that can only be found in the game by breeding specific coats together!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/318c7b42ed785841ab61965c36dc87981bac9c41.png
Skill Inheritance
Foals will of course inherit the skills of their parents in addition to their coat colors. While the foal's skills will be lower than their parents', they will also have full potential which will help them outperform their parents once they've been fully trained. When personality traits are added later on during Early Access, these will also have a chance to be inherited by the foal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/aeea5b080ad353162ce937fd083288a6e12a4fc8.png
Life Stages
When catching a wild horse or purchasing a horse at the auction house, they are already adults. To raise a horse through different life stages, you’ll have to breed your own horses and raise them on your ranch! Here is more information on the characteristics of each life stage.

Foal
Foals are born after 7 days of gestation. They stay foals for 14 days before becoming yearlings, and they will slowly become bigger foals throughout this stage. Foals can’t be mounted or trained, but they can still be led around the ranch and need to be cared for daily.

Yearling
Horses reach this stage after 14 in game days. Yearlings can now be mounted and trained, but they are limited only to beginner competitions. The main advantage of yearlings is that they don’t lose daily potential, so it's a good time to maximize their training before they become adults.

Adult
Horses reach this stage at 28 in game days. They will stay at this stage forever as adulthood is the last life stage of horses. They’re able to do the most amount of activities such as all levels of competition, training and breeding.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/2479eae701214f111eb8779eaf9da764cd896662.png
Pregnant & Nursing Mare
While it’s not exactly a life stage, mares will also be limited in the activities they can do during pregnancy. They can still be ridden and trained, but they won’t be able to participate in competitions or to be sold at the auction house. While the foal is growing up, the mare will then be nursing and won’t be able to become pregnant again until the foal becomes a yearling.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/4b84d53f65356c4ade206c6641768325f2ab0beb.png
Raising Foals
Once a foal is born, they’ll stay in their mother’s stall until they become yearlings. You’ll still need to take care of them daily by brushing them and feeding them milk. Foals can either be kept in the stable or in the pasture. 

Future Additions
Later on, I’ll add more interactions with the foals and ways to train them. As of right now, trust is the only skill that can be increased during the foal stage. I’ll add unique groundwork activities that can be done with the foals to increase their other skills such as jump, speed, endurance and flexibility before they become yearlings.

Ranch Upgrades
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/f591eb5c0e7c6137236121da1d83a0e71d8e13cb.gif
Stable
The stable is the main building you’ll want to upgrade on your ranch, as it will allow you to keep more horses on your ranch. At the start of the game, you’ll have 2 stalls available, and you’ll be able to upgrade the stables to keep 4, 8 and finally 12 horses!

Pastures
While the main pasture will be available from the start of the game, you’ll be able to repair two additional pastures later on. This will allow you to separate your herd into different pastures, or leave all the gates open to give your horses more space to roam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/8eeb3a762df0a2127b3459ac7df70cd1b69fd7df.gif
Indoor Arena
The indoor arena can be found at the back of the ranch. I plan on adding a bonus to training indoors instead of outdoors during certain weather conditions, such as while it’s raining, at nighttime or during winter!

Round Pen
The round pen will be used to do unique training activities with the foal such as lunging and groundwork. This won’t be available from the start of Early Access but will be added later on along with the foal training!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/696ec57cc77fde7add2cf8d3294463a7db591769.png
Four Seasons
As we’re approaching the Early Access release, I decided to create a seasonal loop, with each new season bringing its own features. Here’s what I’ve implemented for now:

 Music that changes with the seasons on the ranch. You can already listen to some of the tracks you’ll hear throughout the seasons here!
 Different foliage and environments to fit each season’s color palette!
 New forage to gather around the trails as the seasons change.
 Different crops that can be grown on your ranch.
Throughout the development in Early Access, I’d like to give each season more personality with unique seasonal elements, for example:

 Seasonal events such as an easter egg hunt in spring and halloween in fall.
 Unique interactions such as snowballs to roll and piles of leaves to run through.
 Different weather such as foggy days in fall, storms in summer and snow in winter.
Future Updates
I’ll now be continuing to work on new content that I want to include in The Ranch of Rivershine EA release. This includes new villagers, new trails, quests and general improvement based on the feedback I’ve received from the demo. Thank you for reading about my progress on The Ranch of Rivershine!🍀

General Update

 Fixed a bug where the horse controls would always be set to “Free Camera” when leaving the stables.

notes.title: Devlog #9 Demo Announcement!! 🐴✨
notes.content:
Hi ranchers!! 🐴✨ I hope you’re all having a great start to 2023 ❤️ I have some really exciting news to share for The Ranch of Rivershine!

Upcoming Demo

Horse Statue

Town Travelers

notes.title: Devlog #8 Crop Farm & New Townsfolk!
notes.content:
Hi ranchers!❄️☃️ Here is our last devlog of 2022... Time flew by! Though I'm happy to say I've made good progress with The Ranch of Rivershine and will have great news to share very early in 2023!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/8adcade7d51438532d5ef46645a842a837288868.png
Crop Farm
Time to grow some crops! You’ll now be able to grow a variety of seeds into orchard grass, alfalfa hay, carrots, oats, milo and more! In addition to planting seeds, you’ll be able to use different fertilizers to help your crops along. For example, you can use fertilizer to increase your crop yield, make them grow faster or grow crops out of season by protecting them from the harsh weather.

While being a farmer is not the main job you’ll have on your ranch, it’s always handy (and cheaper!) to grow feed for your horses yourself. Not to worry, farming is quite simple in Rivershine and won’t take too much of your time. No need to water your plants everyday, just plant your seeds during the correct season and they’ll happily grow on their own!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/90a3cfb101c233b86cefe0540094458a107fc9e8.png
The Farmer
Here’s our first new villager, Aisha! She’ll introduce you to farming and supply everything you might need, from fertilizer to seeds… or even the crops, in case your harvest didn't turn out well! 

She lives in the Lupine Meadow, so you won’t be able to visit her until you gain access to the trail leading there. Luckily, the villagers who live outside of town still visit the town’s marketplace from time to time, so you might be able to catch her there!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/d6ed954355564f0b15e6160d195b2106ceb86e70.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/8b65c239843c6a28b2d13c5c39daf37a8461cbc9.png
The Carpenter
Meet our second new villager, Liam! He’ll help you build various additions and upgrades to your ranch, such as expanding your stables or building a new arena. For now, he can help you set up your farm by building plots where you can grow crops.

He also lives outside of town, in the Pine Forest… I’ll be sharing more about that area in our next devlog!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/1d2a13cff0ce48aab50b77556eb66f3257fb1e1b.png
Townsfolk Trade
While you’ll need most of the crops you grow to feed your own horses, you’ll probably end up with a bit of extra to sell in town! The villagers can now purchase produce from you. This will help you make a bit of extra money on the side, along with participating in competitions and trading horses in the auction house!

[previewyoutube=diIrW9RLxRE;full][/previewyoutube]
Rivershine Town Music
Since you’ll be spending more time around town, you'll be able to hear a new track as the night settles in town... Or listen to it here for a sneak peek of the Rivershine soundtrack!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/f4b6a3a3edc19913df249e133be1b3fb39159927.png
Mail Delivery
You’ve got mail! Upon waking up, you’ll now receive mail from your fellow townsfolk who might want to have a chat with you, announce good news, invite you to a competition or ask for your help… And if you have to lend them a hand, there’s usually a reward involved!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/7ccd3353abc1c9bd31ad7bf99fdaba81f0c9ad32.png
Quest Tracker
As I’ve recently been working on the quest system, I added a new tab to keep track of the quests you currently have. This gives you information on what to do and the rewards you’ll gain for it. Additionally, you can keep a mini quest visible in your HUD or hide it from here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/7cecf94cd03c1f826192e168079c72874138bb4a.png
Settings & Controls
Finally, I've also been working on improving the quality of life of the game as we approach a playable version! I added a controls rebind menu and a settings menu that includes different graphics quality to run the game smoothly on more computers. This will require more testing though and will most likely be improved once I get player feedback on the game’s performance!

Thank you everyone for your support and I wish you all happy holidays! ☃️❄️

notes.title: Devlog #7 Lupine Meadow
notes.content:
Hi ranchers!!🐑🍀 I’m back with a new devlog for The Ranch of Rivershine, featuring riding trails, sheep, a new villager and a sneak peek at Rivershine's original soundtrack! ❤️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/6e28542c5d854a601c3ebbdb86cca60b867578ac.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/4a1735e4142da5ae49e0ac0864cfa74a961ef089.png
Lupine Meadow
The main addition to Rivershine this month is the first trail riding area, the Lupine Meadow! This vast, open field features a large maze to explore on horseback, a flock of sheep to chase around and a farm where you’ll be able to buy hay and grain for your horses!

The Lupine Meadow also has its own original music, which you can already listen to here! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/1abcdfd3f3e2ab97f1b62df042ab77f16f36ad59.png
Friendly Sheep
To add a bit of life to these new environments, I’ve started adding other animals you can encounter in addition to horses! You’ll now find sheep you can chase and herd together. Later on, I think it would be fun to add a minigame where you can lead them back to their enclosure every day for a bit of money… But for now, they’re free to roam the meadow!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/7c9ded9d4129fdff8ed2f9e752a2873397bca666.png
New Competitions
Since we now have access to a new area, I’ve also added four cross country courses you can unlock in the Lupine Meadow! These competitions are all a bit harder than the town competitions already in the game, but the prizes for winning are also higher!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/504640ee3429af7df364779880bd0fe4bfe5ab6d.png
New Character
I’m very happy to introduce the fourth character I've added to Rivershine… Jai Maji! You’ll encounter this villager early on in the game as he lives in town. As a ranger, his job is to run the park office and help you access and upgrade the trail riding areas… He might even have a few tips about wild horses he’s seen while exploring the trails!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/d37329c421ee984f0d6ade1d36f385c22ae48927.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/6f3edb673da7a164dd5df9d77ea0dbb0d2dfdad8.png
Meadow Upgrades
After unlocking access to the Lupine Meadow, you’ll be able to further upgrade the trails by adding obstacles of different difficulties around the map. This will allow you to practice cross country and add a little bit of challenge as you’re riding around the meadow!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/40eb1569f9914e16a67e43a0e84a8a0f566e02a0.png
World Map
As the world got bigger, it became obvious the player would need a little help to find their way around! I’ve added a map for each zone currently in the game, which is the ranch, the town and the meadow. Each map contains information about the main interest points in that area, such as the trails to neighboring areas, the shops and where the villagers are.
