New Logo
Finally, as you might have already noticed, we have adorable new cover art for the game, drawn by the amazing Kyu!

Thank you everyone for following my progress with The Ranch of Rivershine! Feel free to comment about what you’d like to see next in the game, or if you have any questions about what I’ve shared in this devlog!

notes.title: Devlog #6 Tutorial & Character Creation
notes.content:
Hi ranchers! I’m back with a new devlog for my progress on The Ranch of Rivershine this summer! 🌼🌼

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/be8f95cd70d79cb48822102fa5f820517dcac1b1.png
Tutorial & Quests
The main feature I've worked on this month is the first day tutorial. The tutorial includes multiple events to introduce all of the core features in the game, such as purchasing your first horse at the auction house, participating in a riding lesson, meeting fellow villagers, exploring your ranch and taking care of your new horse.

Along with the tutorial, there are also going to be quests you’ll receive as you progress in the game. These quests can include, for example, collecting certain items, training a horse to a specific skill level, winning a competition or exploring a new area. The main rewards earned from completing quests will be unlocking new cross country competitions to participate in, or some money to spend in town!

I also posted a new video going more in depth on what the tutorial contains if you're curious to see how it looks in game! ✨

[previewyoutube=gVXEv0e1nvc;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/3d6719390b49f363d26a98d895cd3931f3ad543f.png
Villagers & Shops
Now that you’ll be earning money from quests and competitions, you’ll also be able to spend money! Of course, you’ll be able to spend money on horses in the auction house, but there’ll be more things to purchase such as equipment, tools and treats to care for your horses.

For now there are only three stores open in town, but I’ll be adding more specialty shops as I add new villagers to Rivershine!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/504ac6803a6570a186d6f91725850a483fac3f38.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/a3cee89a469d19bfb8e70784e63f48b28ac54635.png
Arena Courses
In addition to tools and items, you’ll be able to purchase upgrades for your ranch, such as new obstacle courses! These can be used both in your outdoor and indoor arenas to train your horses whenever you want. The courses are sold by the trainer, who offers a variety of obstacle styles and difficulty levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/d306cd513f6717a290b0d2a6fc234c324eb23afa.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/d1e35fedd6622296a92906c3dad8b1f933a4d06d.gif

After getting feedback from a few playtesters this month, I worked on improving the controls both while riding a horse and on foot. You’ll now be able to spin your horse on itself to change your direction and run around with 8-directional movement, which is really useful when you’re leading your horse!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/9465dee8d748f1c7584edbe033e50f6efcb80e60.png
Rider Animations
I’ve added more interactions for the rider to create synergy between the player and rider. For example, the rider now squeezes its leg when going up in speed, and will lean forward or backward when going up and down hills. 

In addition, you might also catch the rider petting the horse’s neck, looking around or stretching their feet out of the stirrups when you stay idle for a bit!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/fe7992fce0cbc09c5d621a67b77bb4c9124d06f6.png
Character Creation
Finally, I’ve implemented a character creation system! There aren't a ton of options for now but I’ll be adding more clothes, hairstyles and other details along development. You’ll be able to customize your character at the very start of the game, and then change it again whenever you want from the wardrobe in your house.

Thank you everyone for following the development of The Ranch of Rivershine and I wish you all a cozy fall! ❤️

notes.title: Devlog #5 🌄 Cross Country & Ranch Life!
notes.content:
Hi ranchers, I hope your summer is going well! I’m back with a ton of progress to share about The Ranch of Rivershine! In the past month I've been focused on implementing competitions and adding more interactions with your horses! 🍎🐴

Cross Country Competitions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/02270c40cab46acbeddf8cba523c4d05cfaaa432.png
Overview
The cross country competitions are the main way you'll be able to progress in the game and earn money. You’ll be able to access more competitions by completing quests, unlocking new areas and training your horses to a higher skill level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/63b9caa9d92455c99aff097d1c9019d7c602930d.png
Difficulty Level
Competitions are ranked between 4 different difficulties: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced and Expert. You’ll need a horse with the required jump skill level to participate in higher level competitions, so make sure to keep up with their training! 

There will be 6 unique maps for the competitions, each with all 4 levels of difficulty, for a total of 24 unique cross country courses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/cbbf522dec8a2ea5e0c097b17498c59fce565ba5.png
Prizes & Ribbons
Winning competitions is pretty straightforward, as your only goal is to cross all obstacles as quickly as possible. Depending on your time, you’ll place between the 1st and 6th position and earn the corresponding prize and ribbon. Each ribbon your horse wins will be displayed in their stall and will increase their value at the auction house, so make sure to perform your best!

Earlier last month, I released a video showcasing gameplay footage of the competitions and talking more in depth about this feature. If you’re curious to know more about the cross country, be sure to check this out!

[previewyoutube=b1HnPdgqCy4;full][/previewyoutube]
Ranch Improvement
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/dd85ffe3d869b01fda53301c16e66d20f106009a.png
Stable
The stable got a new look! As it’s now more spacious and with bigger windows, it’s easy to see your horses from the outside and get more natural light in. This 4 stall stable is the second upgrade you’ll be able to get for this building, as it can be upgraded from 2 to 12 stalls!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/edfbbcb19a74158dc9c13475bc57310586dc4375.png
Pastures
The pasture has been expanded from having only one large fenced area, to four of them! Each area is separated by gates you can open and close to control which pastures your horses have access to, and which horses should be kept together in the same pasture. This will come in handy when breeding is added, as you might want to keep stallions and mares separate!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/ef0d6613fd3380fd4f46e8d17f47daee123379cd.png
Arenas
Here’s an overview of the training area on your ranch, with the round pen as a new addition! While the round pen doesn’t currently offer any unique training activities, it will come in handy when I add foals later on. They will have their own training techniques, such as lunging, walking over obstacles or being introduced to equipment. These activities will mostly take place in the round pen, so keep an eye out for what I’ll add here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/89d3bb7624400fdee5d80f0776912cb47a114c9d.png
Wild Forage
You can now gather items in the wild to give to your horses! As you feed hay, grains and treats to your horses daily, they will need a lot of consumable items to be kept healthy. These items can either be purchased in a shop or, if you’d rather save some money, foraged around the ranch and the town!

As I add more areas and different seasons in the game, the items you’ll find will also change depending on the weather and area you’re exploring.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/51c9f6e0687ceaadc38e16a9507675451187508c.png
Horse Treats
In addition to hay and grains, you can now also give your horse a treat every day! Treats are usually fruits or vegetables, such as carrots and apples. Compared to hay and grains, which are usually given in the morning, treats are best given in the middle of the day to increase your horse’s energy. 

Energy is lost as you do activities with your horse, such as training them or participating in competitions. If your horse has lost too much energy, they won’t be able to do much, or even gallop for the rest of the day! It’s handy to carry treats with you in case your horse needs a little energy boost.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/8b2fd50249944dc55430ac685f3d9a638a8bd4de.png
Halter Lead
Horses can now be led around with a halter! It’s useful to move your horse around in the pasture, bring them in and out of the stable, or simply to have them follow you around! Once you’ve earned a horse's trust, you’ll be able to simply whistle for them to follow you. But foals and new horses will need to be led until they get to know you better!

Finally, I wanted to share a video I just posted talking more in depth about all the new features I’ve added in July! If you’d like to see these new features in action, be sure to check it out here!

[previewyoutube=mvJfXQ4lq5o;full][/previewyoutube]

Take care everyone! ❤️
Éloïse

notes.title: Devlog #4 🐴 The Town of Rivershine & Its Villagers!
notes.content:
Hi ranchers! 🐴 Development for The Ranch of Rivershine has been going really well this spring, which means I have a ton of new features to share in this devlog... So let's saddle up!

Rivershine Town
After working on this level for months, I'm happy to finally share a full overlook of the town! This is where you'll begin your adventure, meet your fellow townsfolks, visit shops, bid in the auction house and start competing in cross country!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/e82ff736e067287b8a0c01567a3e0f6aaddf70f4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/7c11cd5238ca2e786ef0704f7fbdf612a3a5d5d7.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/42e26ffa9013c5e29706d05a691fbc3443ed0d6e.png

For now, the buildings are mostly empty indoors. I'll be modeling furniture and decorating the villagers' houses as I add more townsfolks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/a6f33e5432a66ad56538c07583e1fc418eac7eac.png

If you're curious about the town's ambience, make sure to listen to the music composed by Matthew Harnage for the town! The game will feature a full original soundtrack, with unique tracks for each areas you'll explore!

River & Waterfall
I also took some time to create nice water shaders and particle effects. Considering the name of the town, I figured the river should take a central part of it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/75b2966f1b90f130bff99770a90b2a02c4b8566b.png

Villagers Behavior & Dialogue
Now we'll need some townsfolks to populate Rivershine! I've created the first villager you'll meet in town... Madelaine Beauchamp, the auctioneer! She'll help you buy your first horse after arriving in town and get you set up for competitions. 

The first step to interacting with villagers is a dialogue system, which I've now implemented. There's still a ton of content I'll need to write for tutorials, quests and the storyline, so this will be an ongoing effort. But I'm happy we can get chatting with the villagers! 

Additionally, I've also been implementing a schedule for the villagers. This means that they'll change their behavior depending on the season, weekday and hour. Their schedule will impact for example when they sleep, when they open their store and where you can find them. But I want to add even more actions to their daily life, which brings me to our next feature!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/6c36d38b8b59916d5fc2535419ba9d4685544632.png

Furniture Interaction
To add more depth to the villagers' daily schedule, they'll need to be able to interact with furniture and tools. This will allow them to do a lot of different actions like go to sleep, sweep with a broom, brush a horse or eat a meal at the table. As I've just started implementing this system they can for now sit down, lay down and open doors. A good start, but I'll still have a lot more to add here!

You will also be able to use furniture just as the villagers do, so for example you'll be able to sit down at a table with them. While this doesn't add to the gameplay, I'm hoping that fans of roleplaying will enjoy this detail!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/12e593293d9e18e3f0336fbee0cb2c0b6e7fda31.png

Horse Mane & Tail
Now before the end of this devlog, let's get back to horse business! I've been redesigning the horses' manes and tails to add physics, different lengths of hair, multiple colors and patterns. I'm loving how unique and nicer this makes the horses look!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/1c24c076c68dd1ac225ee2716d514f0b2fb7c07b.png

Thank you everyone for following my work on The Ranch of Rivershine! Please feel free to ask me if you have any questions about the game, or hop on the Discord if you'd like to join the game's community! ❤️

notes.title: Devlog #3 Whistling, Jumping, Indoor Arena & More!
notes.content:
Hi ranchers! 🌱 I'm back today with a lot of new content for The Ranch of Rivershine. I took a little break to work on my other game Capybara Spa, but now that it's released, I'll be focusing 100% on this game until it's complete!! 

[previewyoutube=HH2y1WZ3Wp0;full][/previewyoutube]
A Day At The Ranch
Before we get into this devlog, I wanted to share a gameplay video I just posted on Youtube! This showcases a lot of the new features mentioned in this devlog and a full tour of the player’s ranch. While everything is still a work in progress, this might give you a better idea of what it’ll be like to spend some time at The Ranch of Rivershine!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/1758c97a4962bdf92de7855ffbbfe0e986423b7a.png
Horse Whistle
You can now whistle and call your horse over! Based on the trust your horse has for you, they’ll walk, trot or canter over. But keep in mind this only works if the horse is close enough to you, and will work from further away the more your horse likes you! Unless they’re still getting to know you, in which case… they won’t come over at all!

Whistling works both in the pasture, where multiple horses can hear you and come over, or when you’re out exploring trails with a horse. Be sure to spend time increasing your horses trust for you, so you won’t have to run around chasing them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/044408805f4fc1d779aa36b1f0a7bd73f3092da4.png
Better rider
I’ve added more controls to make the horseback riding smoother. You can now stop quickly from a canter or a gallop, and walk backwards. While walking backwards on a horse is not easy, it will improve over time with your horse’s speed and flexibility skills.

You can now also change your controls to suit your playstyle better! Quickly change from freely moving the camera around and using the direction arrows to control your horse, or lock in the camera and use it to steer your horse in the right direction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/0c65b3295f5d91bc606691a905c26be6148f5985.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/6e04ad893fc8bb77a543419ea7ae01e5d67c96e6.png
Jump Difficulty
You can now train your horse to jump higher obstacles, and from a wider angle of approach! When approaching an obstacle, you'll now see a guide that will show if you can jump the obstacle.

If the whole guide is red, the jump is too high for your horse. If a section of it is yellow, it means the jump can be cleared if you approach it from the correct angle. An unexperienced horse will have to approach the obstacle face on to jump it correctly, while an experienced horse will be able to clear it from any angle! Once you see the guide turn green, it's time to quickly press jump to clear it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/cc9b0b2e1248c2b836b5ce58fa0bd75e5b87ecdb.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/e315161fd50da3a385ea844975673a3c5f0e938c.png
Indoor Arena
In addition to the outdoor arena on your ranch, you’ll be able to build an indoor arena! This will come in handy on rainy or snowy days, where horses would struggle to focus on training outdoors. It also gives you a really pretty view of your ranch!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/6d517c911b17b6acd3226b519d5dc8d97bdc2cd3.png
Fellow Villagers
I'm really excited to introduce the first three characters we'll have in Rivershine! From left to right, we have the auctioneer, the trainer and the grocer! I'll go more in depth about each character as I add them in the game, but I just wanted to share their adorable portraits with you all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/c00eeed53c50ac12bec11ee1f146b7c5e2afa004.png
Upcoming Features
I’m now shifting my focus to adding the villagers and the town they’ll live in! This will be a huge addition to the game as you’ll then be able to visit shops in town, purchase items and equipment for your horses, complete quests and chat with your fellow townspeople! This will take a while to complete, but I'll be sure to share more of my progress here!

Take care everyone!
Éloïse 🌱

notes.title: Devlog #2: Trail Ride & Horse Care Minigame!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Here’s what I’ve been working for The Ranch of Rivershine in October! :)

Meadow Trail Map

I’ve started working on the first trail map, the Lupine Meadow Path! Trail maps will be a core feature in The Ranch of Rivershine. Up to five trail maps can be unlocked and upgraded throughout the game, and each will be unique in their own way, including different environments and an original music track for each map!

You’ll be able to explore the trail and practice cross country with your horse as you’ll encounter natural obstacles. Forageable items such as wheat, oat, corn and hay can be found and gathered to feed your horses. If you’re lucky, you might even find a wild horse wandering around!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/180e8e7513891d0a4af27a6ed6def0a8215d1b4a.png

Horse Feed

When your horse is in the stables, you’ll be able to do different care activities, such as brushing & feeding your horse. These activities increase your horse’s statistics such as their health and cleanliness.

You’ll be able to feed your horse hay, grains and a snack every day. Multiple feed options will be available, as long as you have it in stock! You’ll be able to get feed either by gathering it in the wild, growing it in your fields or purchasing it in town. Be sure not to forget to feed your horse, or it might fall ill!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/f08fae0103d52493fd6f843266ea658e7351b5aa.png

Stall Mucking

To keep your horses healthy, you’ll also have to keep their stall clean and add bedding to make it extra comfy! You’ll be able to avoid mucking stalls by leaving your horses to sleep in the pasture overnight, however, they’ll also be left with a lower energy level the following day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/76d9594dcd2babdfec65cd92f625f6afeddb623f.png

New Coats

Multiple coat patterns will be available in the game, such as appaloosa, splash and tobiano! I’ll be adding more patterns and colors over time. This month, I made three variations of the frame overo pattern and six new face markings!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/f08cf8546b929b0f65d697838342882ab55d3ec7.png

English Tack

I’ve also added an english saddle and saddle pad so you’ll be able to change up the looks of your horse’s equipment!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/c3248574936876e34f851122a41d678ff2df2d7d.png

I’ll be taking a break in November from working on The Ranch of Rivershine to begin a small side project. I’ll be coming back to developing Rivershine and sharing more updates very soon though! Thank you :)

notes.title: Devlog #1: Horse Auction House & Training Arena!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Thank you all so much for your support since I announced The Ranch of Rivershine last month! Since then, I’ve been working on a few features I’ll be sharing with you all today!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/e7cb3f0ba3ca5b373c8a088eaf0dc0a025f76b01.png

Auction House

Welcome to the Rivershine auction house! Here you’ll be able to purchase new horses and sell your own horses. However, get ready to outbid other buyers if you really want to win a horse!

Horses available for purchase are separated in four different tiers, which determines their skill levels, coat rarity and value. Higher tiers will be unlocked in the auction house as you progress through the game and increase Rivershine’s popularity! You’ll also be able to sell horses at the auction house. The starting price is set by the auctioneer based on your horse's skill level, health and coat color. Depending on your luck, your horse might sell for its lowest price or it might start a bidding war between the buyers!

I might also add weekly special auctions later on, where other animals such as donkeys, cows or goats could be sold, along with horses with unique coat colors! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/c76816390b3d1085f3cefd573139cf71abc039d8.png

Training Arena

An important part of raising your horses is to improve their skills, such as speed, endurance, flexibility and jump. Each of these can be improved by riding the horse and practicing different activities. While horses can be trained everywhere, such as around the town or on a forest trail, the arena is always an efficient way to do it.

When entering the arena, you’ll be able to select different difficulties and obstacle styles. This will place a unique obstacle course in the arena for you to train your horse. Later on, I’ll also be adding western gymkhana courses such as barrel racing, pole weaving and keyhole racing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/8cf36a559b0b9a356e82ee5120c70d63dab20b04.png

Day & Night Cycle

Your life on the ranch will be set by the rhythm of each day. Wake up at sunrise, and be sure to be back in bed by midnight! Each passing day will also impact your horses as they’ll grow up & will need to be fed and brushed.

Later on, weekdays will also come into play as it will determine when stores are open, special events and the NPCs daily schedule. I’m also planning on adding seasons to change up the landscape around Rivershine!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/2c61d0d85c9ff68d99f6d07b9712df3528e52c16.png

Main Menu

I’ve been working on preparing the game for alpha access, which includes creating a main menu! Along with it I’ve added a save & load system, with multiple save slots available. This menu also includes an overview of your ranch, and you’ll be able to see the horses you left in the pasture walk around whenever you open the game back up!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079595/c5b266d003d2092ca8f5216b43e87fc0288ee57c.png

Next Month

My plans for the upcoming month is to work on the inventory system and add foragable items around the ranch, such as wheat & oats to feed your horses. I’ll also start working on the town map, where you’ll find a variety of buildings such as shops, NPCs’ houses and the auction house! While The Ranch of Rivershine isn’t quite ready for an alpha access yet, I’ll be sure to keep you all posted once we can start doing a bit of playtesting!

If you’d like to see me work live on the game, be sure to visit my Twitch channel here! I’ll be happy to chat with you and answer questions about the development of the game. :)
